subject: shiny no longer responds to button clicks after 2 submits, when a legend is attached to leaflet map

messages.author: bca33556bc68881c
messages.subject: shiny no longer responds to button clicks after 2 submits, when a legend is attached to leaflet map
parts:
Hi there,

I am encountering a rather strange problem in the integration of shiny and leaflet:

I am using an action button input$queryExec to trigger the query of data and rendering of map. Each time this button is clicked, the map adjusted accordingly. However, if I add a legend to the map, then after exactly 2 button clicks (or 2 submits) based on whatever selection criteria, shiny does not react any more. The leaflet widget remain working, but it is no longer updated accordingly. I also added a print statement for the button to debug at runtime, but after 2 clicks nothing is printed. It means shiny no longer receives the value change of the button. Here is part of the code:

  results <- reactive({
    input$queryExec
    if (input$queryExec > 0) {
      sumResults <- SPARQL(endpoint, isolate(filteredQuery()), curl_args=list(userpwd="rstudio:rstudio", httpauth=TRUE))$results
      sumResults <- data.frame(refArea = sumResults[, 1], num = sumResults[, 2])
      sumResults
    }
  })
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    m <- leaflet() %>%
      addTiles() %>% 
      fitBounds(6.333618, 49.484186, 2.510375, 51.476251)
 
# leave out some manipulations
 
      m %>% 
        addPolygons(data = polygons, 
                    fillColor = pal(newObsVal),
                    fillOpacity = 0.8, 
                    color = "#BDBDC3",
                    weight = 1,
                    popup = popup) %>%
        addLegend(pal = palLegend, values = bins, position = 'bottomright', title = NULL) %>% 
        clearBounds() 
    }
    
  })

If I remove the statement "addLegend", the application will work properly. Then it will always respond, whatever the selection criteria is. So I wonder the problem is from the leaflet side and it should not be my responsibilty :D 

Before opening a new issue at the leaflet github repo, I would like to post this question here and see if it is a bug of leaflet or a bug of myself. :D Has anybody else encountered such type of issue? Any help is appreciated. Thank you very much in advance and have a nice day!

Regards,
Yang

parts:
Hi Joe,

Thank you very much for your suggestion. I did check the javascript console as soon as I discovered this issue. There is no error or warning. The only thing displayed is
"Consider using 'dppx' units, as in CSS 'dpi' means dots-per-CSS-inch, not dots-per-physical-inch, so does not correspond to the actual 'dpi' of a screen. In media query expression: (min-resolution: 144dpi)" during startup. It shouldn't be related to this issue.

I tried your suggestion, opening 2 or 3 new tabs for the same app. The newly created apps will work at the beginning, but do not react again after 2 queries, all of them. Any clue?

Regards,
Yang
